raw_text:
PLAN "Post-Illness Reconditioning Block"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Restore pre-illness strength in bench, squat, and deadlift over 3 weeks"

PHASES
  PHASE "Reconditioning" (3 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper Reintroduction":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
          arm_circles 1m
          scapular_retraction 2x10
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 2x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          lat_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower Reintroduction":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
          leg_swings 1m
          hip_circles 1m
          glute_bridge 2x12
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x30 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 1m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full Body Light":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
          cat_cow 1m
          bird_dog 2x10
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x5 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          lateral_raise 2x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Build":
        warmup:
          cycling 6m
          scapular_retraction 2x10
          prone_Y 2x10
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 4x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          dip 3x8 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 2x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          lat_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower Build":
        warmup:
          walking 6m
          leg_swings 1m
          goblet_squat 2x8
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 1m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          pigeon_pose 2m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Deadlift Focus":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
          cat_cow 1m
          glute_bridge 2x12
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x4 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 2x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          skull_crusher 2x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 1m
          spinal_twist 1m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Bench Peak":
        warmup:
          cycling 6m
          scapular_retraction 2x10
          bench_press 2x5 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          pull_up 3x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 65m "Squat Peak":
        warmup:
          walking 6m
          leg_swings 1m
          squat 2x5 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x3 rpe 8 rest 210 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x10 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 1m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 65m "Deadlift Peak":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
          cat_cow 1m
          deadlift 2x3 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x3 rpe 8 rest 210 seconds
          incline_press 3x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          cable_row 3x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x60 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 1m
          spinal_twist 1m
          child_pose 2m

goals.name: Restore pre-illness strength in bench, squat, and deadlift over 3 weeks
